result.rationale: The model's before_validation block calls `self.host.sub!(...)` with no nil guard (embeddable_host.rb), and the model declares only `validates_format_of :host`, no presence validation. The controller `save_host` assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` directly and relies on `host.save` failing to hit `render_json_error`. If `host` is nil, `before_validation` raises NoMethodError before validation runs, producing a 500 instead of a 4xx. The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: before_validation calls `self.host.sub!` with no nil guard and the model declares no presence validation, so saving a record whose host attribute is nil raises NoMethodError before the format validation can produce an error. A staff request to POST/PUT /admin/embeddable_hosts whose embeddable_host params omit `host` returns a 500 (NoMethodError on nil.sub!) instead of the 4xx validation error the render_json_error branch exists to return.
